purpose: find, test and embed process changes that reduce delay, rework or risk, and show whether they worked
entry_criteria: A process with measurable pain exists
Process data or the means to collect it exists
A process owner agrees to change
inputs: cycle time, rework and defect data
feedback from people who do the work
procedure: Pick one process and measure it first: cycle time, waiting time, rework and defects.
Map the actual process with the people who do it and mark where work waits or loops back.
Choose the largest cause and design a small change with an expected effect on a named measure.
Trial it for a fixed period with a few teams, comparing with the baseline.
Adopt, adjust or drop based on the result; update the documented process if adopted.
Share what was learned and revisit the measure after several months.
acceptance_criteria: A baseline exists before the change
The trial has a period and a measure

validation.check: compare cycle time for the trial period with the baseline period
check the process document reflects the adopted change

failure_modes.response: Involve the people who do the work
Review later and embed the change in tooling

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Pull requests wait a median of 30 hours for review. Two trial teams adopt a daily review slot and the median falls to 12 hours over four weeks; the process page is updated and the slot adopted by other teams.
